title: Web GUI list view with drag-and-drop ranking
description:
Step 4 of the build order. A React GUI served by the daemon (embedded in the binary from `internal/webui/dist`) that calls the Connect API with `connect-es`.

List view: projects → ranked features → ranked tasks, showing effective status, blocked state and claims. Drag-and-drop reranking via MoveItem. The user can create and edit items, promote drafts, set status (including done) and delete.

Live updates come from the WatchItems streaming RPC.
